mapper.sql: select p.payment_id, p.batch_id, p.amount, p.paid_at, p.pay_method, p.voucher_url, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.remark, b.batch_no, s.station_name, bu.buyer_name from gas_purchase_payment p left join gas_purchase_batch b on p.batch_id = b.batch_id left join gas_station s on b.station_id = s.station_id left join gas_buyer bu on b.buyer_id = bu.buyer_id
mapper.insert: insert into gas_purchase_payment( batch_id, amount, paid_at, pay_method, voucher_url, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{batchId}, #{amount}, #{paidAt}, #{payMethod}, #{voucherUrl}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
